scanNote:
WORKBOOK 13-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (54-bet, PDF 52). Yuqorida to'q sariq yorliqda 'UNIT 13', yonida katta qora 'Join in the Fun!'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1) 'Label the actors and actresses with their roles (king, wizard, bride, butler) then use the prompts to say what they are wearing using a variety of adjectives, as in the example.' 4 SURAT: 1 kelin (veil, gloves, dress, high-heeled shoes); 2 qirol (crown, necklaces, cloak, gown); 3 xizmatkor (glasses, bow tie, shirt, jacket, trousers) - patnisda ko'za; 4 sehrgar (hat, gown, apron, shoes) - tayoqli, yulduzli libos. Qiya namuna: 'The bride is wearing a long white dress, ...'
2) 'Fill in the appropriate adjectives from the list.' Qiya: 'tasty, funny, local, amazed, incredible, favourite, traditional, exhausted'. 1 The ...... people organised the festival. 2 Everyone had put a(n) ...... amount of work into the show. 3 There was a buffet with really ...... food. 4 I was ...... at the size of the cake. 5 My father's ...... band is the Rolling Stones.

O'NG USTUN (2 davomi): 6 They sang folk songs and danced to ...... music. 7 They were all happy but ...... after the long performance. 8 The comedian's ...... jokes made us laugh.
3) 'Underline the correct word:' 1 The atmosphere at the concert was amazing/generous. 2 Colourful/Noisy kites filled the sky at the kite festival. 3 This celebration is a(n) kind/annual event. 4 I love going to rock/sound concerts. 5 When my party was over I felt amusing/exhausted. 6 The firework display was really stunning/playful.
4) 'Match the words in bold to their opposites in the list.' Qiya: 'plain, good, boring, delighted, disgusting'. 1 The new building had a very elaborate design. 2 The students found the speeches very interesting. 3 The food was really delicious. 4 They were shocked when they heard the bad news. 5 He was disappointed with his fancy dress costume.
5) 'Match the items in the two columns, then make sentences using them.' to play / to start / to wave / to set up | clapping / a guitar / speakers / flags || to bang / to win / to organise / to blow | a prize / drums / whistles / a party. Strelka: to play → a guitar.
6) 'Label the comments with I (for inviting), A (for accepting) or R (for polite refusal).' 1 I'm sorry Bill, but I won't be able to make it to your farewell party. 2 Would you like to come to our barbecue? 3 Oh yes, I'd love to go to the cinema tomorrow night! 4 I'm afraid I've already arranged to visit my aunt that day. 5 Are you interested in coming to the theatre? 6 I'm sorry, I can't. That's the night of my French class. 7 That's very kind of you. What time does it start? 8 We're all going on a picnic on Sunday. Why don't you join us?

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '54'.

exercises.instructionEn: Label the actors and actresses with their roles: king, wizard, bride, butler. 1 veil, gloves, dress, high-heeled shoes; 2 crown, necklaces, cloak, gown; 3 glasses, bow tie, shirt, jacket, trousers; 4 hat, gown, apron, shoes.
exercises.instructionUz: Aktyor va aktrisalarni rollari bilan nomlang: king, wizard, bride, butler. 1 fata, qo'lqop, ko'ylak, baland poshnali tufli; 2 toj, marjonlar, plash, libos; 3 ko'zoynak, kapalak galstuk, ko'ylak, pidjak, shim; 4 shlyapa, libos, fartuk, tufli.
exercises.explanationUz:
ROLLAR va LIBOSLAR (coursebook
  94-bet).

  1 BRIDE (kelin) - veil (fata),
    gloves, white dress,
    high-heeled shoes
  2 KING (qirol) - crown (toj),
    necklaces, cloak (plash), gown
  3 BUTLER (xizmatkor) - glasses,
    bow tie (kapalak galstuk),
    shirt, jacket, trousers
  4 WIZARD (sehrgar) - pointed hat,
    gown with stars, apron, shoes


⚠ 'A BUTLER':

  = bosh xizmatkor (boy uylarda).


⚠ 'A WIZARD':

  = sehrgar (erkak). 'a witch' =
  jodugar (ayol).


⚠ 'A GOWN':

  = uzun libos (kelin/qirol/
  sehrgar).


⚠ 'A CLOAK':

  = plash (yengsiz).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to say what they are wearing using a variety of adjectives, as in the example: The bride is wearing a long white dress, ...
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalar bilan ular nima kiyganini turli sifatlar bilan ayting, namunadagidek: Kelin uzun oq ko'ylak kiygan, ...
exercises.explanationUz:
KIYIM TAVSIFI - SIFATLAR TARTIBI
  (coursebook 20-bet: fikr →
  o'lcham → rang → material).

  QOLIP: X is wearing a + SIFAT +
  SIFAT + OT, ... and ...


⚠ 'HIGH-HEELED SHOES':

  = baland poshnali tufli.


⚠ 'A POINTED HAT':

  = uchli shlyapa.
exercises.exampleEn: The bride is wearing a long white dress, a lace veil, white gloves and high-heeled shoes.
exercises.exampleUz: Kelin uzun oq ko'ylak, to'rli fata, oq qo'lqop va baland poshnali tufli kiygan.
modelAnswers: The king is wearing a gold crown, long gold necklaces, a dark red cloak and a long gown.
The butler is wearing round glasses, a black bow tie, a white shirt, a long black jacket and black trousers.
The wizard is wearing a tall pointed hat, a long dark gown with stars, a big apron and old shoes.
modelAnswersUz: Qirol oltin toj, uzun oltin marjonlar, to'q qizil plash va uzun libos kiygan.
Xizmatkor dumaloq ko'zoynak, qora kapalak galstuk, oq ko'ylak, uzun qora pidjak va qora shim kiygan.
Sehrgar baland uchli shlyapa, yulduzli uzun to'q libos, katta fartuk va eski tufli kiygan.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the appropriate adjectives from the list: tasty, funny, local, amazed, incredible, favourite, traditional, exhausted.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan mos sifatlarni qo'ying: tasty, funny, local, amazed, incredible, favourite, traditional, exhausted.
exercises.explanationUz:
FESTIVAL SIFATLARI (coursebook
  93-bet 5-mashq).

  LOCAL people - mahalliy aholi
  INCREDIBLE amount - aql bovar
    qilmas miqdor
  TASTY food - mazali
  AMAZED at - hayratda
  FAVOURITE band - sevimli guruh
  TRADITIONAL music - an'anaviy
  EXHAUSTED - juda charchagan
  FUNNY jokes - kulgili


⚠ 'AMAZED AT':

  = ... dan hayratda ('at' bilan).


⚠ 'TO PUT WORK INTO':

  = mehnat sarflamoq.


⚠ 'A BUFFET':

  = bufet (o'zi olib yeyish
  dasturxoni). /ˈbʊfeɪ/ - 't'
  o'qilmaydi.


⚠ 'FOLK SONGS':

  = xalq qo'shiqlari.


⚠ 'A COMEDIAN':

  = komediyachi, qiziqchi.

items.uz: Mahalliy aholi festivalni uyushtirdi.

items.sentence: Everyone had put an ___ amount of work into the show.
items.uz: Hamma tomoshaga aql bovar qilmas darajada mehnat sarflagan edi.

items.sentence: There was a buffet with really ___ food.
items.uz: Juda mazali ovqatli bufet bor edi.

items.sentence: I was ___ at the size of the cake.
items.uz: Tortning kattaligidan hayratda qoldim.

items.sentence: My father's ___ band is the Rolling Stones.
items.uz: Otamning sevimli guruhi - Rolling Stones.

items.sentence: They sang folk songs and danced to ___ music.
items.uz: Ular xalq qo'shiqlarini kuylab, an'anaviy musiqaga raqs tushdilar.

items.sentence: They were all happy but ___ after the long performance.
items.uz: Uzoq chiqishdan keyin ularning hammasi xursand, lekin juda charchagan edi.

items.sentence: The comedian's ___ jokes made us laugh.
items.uz: Qiziqchining kulgili hazillari bizni kuldirdi.

exercises.explanationUz:
BAYRAM LUG'ATI.

  amazing atmosphere - ajoyib muhit
  colourful kites - rang-barang
    varraklar
  annual event - yillik tadbir
  rock concerts - rok konsertlari
  exhausted - charchagan (odam)
  stunning display - hayratlanarli
    namoyish


⚠ 'ANNUAL':

  = har yili bo'ladigan.


⚠ 'AMUSING' vs 'EXHAUSTED':

  amusing = kulgili (narsa)
  exhausted = charchagan (odam)
  'I felt EXHAUSTED'.


⚠ 'A FIREWORK DISPLAY':

  = mushakbozlik namoyishi.


⚠ 'STUNNING':

  = hayratlanarli, ajoyib.

items.textEn: The atmosphere at the concert was amazing/generous.
items.uz: Konsertdagi muhit ajoyib edi.

items.textEn: Colourful/Noisy kites filled the sky at the kite festival.
items.uz: Varrak festivalida rang-barang varraklar osmonni to'ldirdi.

items.textEn: This celebration is a(n) kind/annual event.
items.uz: Bu bayram yillik tadbir.

items.textEn: I love going to rock/sound concerts.
items.uz: Rok konsertlariga borishni yaxshi ko'raman.

items.textEn: When my party was over I felt amusing/exhausted.
items.uz: Bazmim tugaganda o'zimni juda charchagan his qildim.

items.textEn: The firework display was really stunning/playful.
items.uz: Mushakbozlik namoyishi chindan hayratlanarli edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the words in bold to their opposites in the list: plain, good, boring, delighted, disgusting. 1 elaborate 2 interesting 3 delicious 4 bad 5 disappointed
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli so'zlarni ro'yxatdagi antonimlariga moslang: plain, good, boring, delighted, disgusting. 1 elaborate 2 interesting 3 delicious 4 bad 5 disappointed
exercises.explanationUz:
ANTONIMLAR:

  elaborate ↔ PLAIN (oddiy)
  interesting ↔ BORING
  delicious ↔ DISGUSTING
  bad ↔ GOOD
  disappointed ↔ DELIGHTED


⚠ 'ELABORATE':

  = murakkab, nafis ishlangan.


⚠ 'A FANCY DRESS COSTUME':

  = maskarad libosi.


⚠ 'DISAPPOINTED':

  = umidi puchga chiqqan, xafa.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the items in the two columns, then make sentences using them: to play, to start, to wave, to set up, to bang, to win, to organise, to blow | clapping, a guitar, speakers, flags, a prize, drums, whistles, a party.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki ustundagi bandlarni moslang, so'ng ular bilan gaplar tuzing: to play, to start, to wave, to set up, to bang, to win, to organise, to blow | clapping, a guitar, speakers, flags, a prize, drums, whistles, a party.
exercises.explanationUz:
FE'L + OT BIRIKMALARI (bayram).

  play a guitar - gitara chalmoq
  start clapping - qarsak chala
    boshlamoq
  wave flags - bayroq silkitmoq
  set up speakers - karnaylarni
    o'rnatmoq
  bang drums - nog'ora chalmoq
  win a prize - sovrin yutmoq
  organise a party - bazm
    uyushtirmoq
  blow whistles - hushtak chalmoq


⚠ 'TO BANG':

  = qattiq urmoq (nog'ora).


⚠ 'SPEAKERS':

  = karnaylar (ovoz kuchaytirgich).


⚠ 'A WHISTLE':

  = hushtak.

pairs.whyUz: ⚠ 'They set up speakers for the concert.'

sections.title: Communication: Inviting, Accepting, Refusing
sections.titleUz: Muloqot: Taklif qilish, qabul qilish, rad etish

exercises.instructionEn: Label the comments with I (for inviting), A (for accepting) or R (for polite refusal).
exercises.instructionUz: Izohlarni I (taklif), A (qabul qilish) yoki R (muloyim rad etish) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAKLIF / QABUL / RAD (coursebook
  95-bet muloqot).

  TAKLIF (I):
    Would you like to come ...?
    Are you interested in coming?
    Why don't you join us?
  QABUL (A):
    Oh yes, I'd love to!
    That's very kind of you. What
    time ...?
  RAD (R):
    I'm sorry, but I won't be able
    to make it.
    I'm afraid I've already arranged
    ...
    I'm sorry, I can't. That's the
    night of ...


⚠ 'TO MAKE IT':

  = yetib kelmoq, qatnashmoq.


⚠ 'A FAREWELL PARTY':

  = xayrlashuv bazmi.


⚠ 'A BARBECUE':

  = barbekyu (ochiq havoda kabob).

items.textEn: I'm sorry Bill, but I won't be able to make it to your farewell party.
items.uz: Kechirasan Bill, lekin xayrlashuv bazmingga kela olmayman.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'I'm sorry, but I won't be able to' → RAD.

items.textEn: Would you like to come to our barbecue?
items.uz: Barbekyumizga kelishni xohlaysanmi?

items.textEn: Oh yes, I'd love to go to the cinema tomorrow night!
items.uz: Ha, ertaga kechqurun kinoga borishni juda xohlayman!

items.textEn: I'm afraid I've already arranged to visit my aunt that day.
items.uz: Afsuski, o'sha kuni xolamnikiga borishni rejalashtirganman.

items.textEn: Are you interested in coming to the theatre?
items.uz: Teatrga borishga qiziqasanmi?

items.textEn: I'm sorry, I can't. That's the night of my French class.
items.uz: Kechirasan, ilojim yo'q. O'sha kecha fransuz tili darsim bor.

items.textEn: That's very kind of you. What time does it start?
items.uz: Juda mehribonsiz. Soat nechada boshlanadi?
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'That's very kind of you' + vaqt so'rash → QABUL.

items.textEn: We're all going on a picnic on Sunday. Why don't you join us?
items.uz: Yakshanba kuni hammamiz piknikka boryapmiz. Nega bizga qo'shilmaysan?
